name: co-memo
description: Local shared memory for coding agents

scripts.build: node scripts/clean.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/prepare-bin.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.format: prettier --write src test scripts package.json tsconfig.json .prettierrc.json README.md CONTRIBUTING.md NOTICE.md docs/*.md skills/**/*.md .github/workflows/ci.yml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src test scripts package.json tsconfig.json .prettierrc.json README.md CONTRIBUTING.md NOTICE.md docs/*.md skills/**/*.md .github/workflows/ci.yml
